title: Young Bucks vs. FTR: rival visions of tag wrestling
summary: Two defining AEW teams return to their rivalry across successive championship matches.

chapters.title: The first AEW showdown
chapters.result: The Young Bucks defeat FTR for the AEW tag titles.
chapters.context: The long-anticipated meeting gives the Bucks the first victory.

chapters.title: FTR even the score
chapters.result: FTR beat the Bucks while defending the ROH and AAA tag titles.
chapters.context: The rematch brings championships from partner promotions onto AEW television.

chapters.title: The Wembley rubber match
chapters.result: FTR retain the AEW tag titles against the Bucks.
chapters.context: The third meeting takes the rivalry to Wembley Stadium.
